term: at least as in a respect
definition: AtLeastIn r c x means c is at least as r as x, permitting equal standing. It is an explicit comparison primitive, not the negation of MoreIn r x c: under a partial order absence of reverse strict comparison may instead mean incomparability. Its relation to MoreIn and applicability to particular qualities are open unless independently specified.
note: Stipulated for the conservative comparison reading: a source-grounded account of each quality and its comparative order would be needed to determine its concrete extension. Neither totality nor a bridge to strict MoreIn is assumed.
